top_signals.title: EST-Floattech to Supply Octopus High Energy Battery Systems for 15 River Cruise Vessels
top_signals.summary: EST-Floattech has been contracted by Dutch system integrator Van Tiem Elektro to supply its Octopus High Energy battery systems for a new series of 15 river cruise vessels.The vessels are being outfitted at De Gerlien van Tiem in Druten, and at Vahali Shipyards in Ghent…
